final_message:
The change will fail.

It fixes the path-variable mismatch and updates rating/text, but:

- Editing a nonexistent review does not return 404; it adds and saves a new review.
- No deletion logic was changed, so deleting a nonexistent review is unlikely to return 404.
- The update method may also mishandle entity persistence by calling `super.save(review)` rather than an update-aware operation.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 99
